expiryPage.title: Expiry Tracker
expiryPage.batchesDesc: Oldest-expiring stock first (FIFO) — remaining quantity is estimated from sales/damage/expiry recorded against each product since the batch arrived. Discount suggestions get steeper the closer a batch gets to its expiry date; refrigerated and frozen items use a much tighter timeline than shelf-stable goods, since they can go from fine to a write-off in days. Use these as a starting point, not a fixed rule.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Quick answers for everyday tasks.
help.searchPlaceholder: What do you want to do?

firstSteps.a: Follow the checklist on the Dashboard: set up the store, add products, put stock on the shelf, invite staff, then make a test sale.

importProducts.q: How do I add many products at once?
importProducts.a: Products → Import. Download the template or use your own spreadsheet (CSV or Excel). We check every row before anything is saved.

receiveStock.q: How do I record a delivery?
receiveStock.a: Stock Arrival → choose the product and quantity. If the product comes in cartons, enter the number of cartons and we work out the units. Add batch and expiry dates for perishables.

moveToShelf.q: Why can't I sell an item I just received?
moveToShelf.a: New stock goes to the backroom. Use Stock Movements → Transfer to shelf to make it available at the till.

sell.q: How do I make a sale?
sell.a: Checkout → Start New Order. Scan barcodes with a scanner or the camera, tap a best seller, or search. Then choose how the customer pays and confirm.

shift.a: A cashier's time on the till. Start a shift with the cash in the drawer, and end it by counting the cash. The Z-report shows any over or short.

discount.q: How do I give a discount?
discount.a: In an open order, tap Discount and enter a % or an amount. Cashiers can give up to the store's limit; bigger discounts need a manager's email and password.

splitPay.q: Customer wants to pay part cash, part card?
splitPay.a: Tap Split payment, add each payment method and amount. Cash can be more than what's due — we show the change.

refund.q: How do I refund or take back an item?
refund.a: Sales & Refunds → find the receipt → View → Refund / return items. Choose quantities; untick Restock for damaged goods. Only managers and admins can refund.

receipts.q: How do I reprint or send a receipt?
receipts.a: Sales & Refunds → View. Print, save as PDF, send on WhatsApp, or share the link. Every receipt also has a QR code to a digital copy.

thermal.q: Can I print to a receipt printer?
thermal.a: Yes, in Chrome or Edge. On a receipt, choose the printer connection (USB, Serial or Bluetooth), then Print to receipt printer. Your browser remembers the printer.

labels.q: How do I print price labels and barcodes?
labels.a: Labels & Barcodes → set how many copies of each product, choose a label size, Print. Products without a barcode can get an in-store barcode in one click.

credit.q: How do I sell on credit (pay later)?
credit.a: Add the customer under Customers, then choose Credit at checkout. Their balance updates automatically; record payments and send WhatsApp reminders from the Customers page.

loyalty.a: Turn them on in Store Settings. Pick the customer as a Loyalty member at checkout so they earn points; use Use points to spend them as a discount.

tax.q: How do I set up VAT or sales tax?
tax.a: Store Settings → Tax. Enter the rate and whether your shelf prices already include tax. Receipts and reports then show the tax.

staff.q: How do I add a cashier?
staff.a: Invites → create an invite with their role and share the code by WhatsApp, SMS or email. Admins can set or reset a staff password from Users.

offline.q: What happens when the internet goes down?
offline.a: Keep selling. Sales and stock changes are saved on the device and sent automatically when the connection returns. The top bar shows how many are waiting.

endOfDay.q: Where do I see today's takings?
endOfDay.a: End of Day shows sales, payment methods, refunds, top items and busiest hours for any date, in your store's time zone.

insights.q: Which products make me the most money?
insights.a: Insights → Profit & margin, ABC analysis and Dead stock show what earns, what's slow, and what is tying up cash.

reorder.a: Replenishment suggests quantities from your sales. Create a purchase order and send it to the supplier as a PDF or on WhatsApp.

security.q: How do I keep my account safe?
security.a: My Account → turn on Two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app. If a phone is lost, use Sign out all other devices and change your password.

export.q: How do I download my data?
export.a: Admins can export store data (CSV/JSON) from Export. Anyone can download their personal data from My Account.

support.a: Support → New ticket. Our team replies in the app.
